interpretation.label: centered_cue_key_restores_anchor_differentiation

preconditions.name: R1_raw_zworld_common_mode_offset_present
preconditions.description: PREMISE gate. SD-077 is conditioned on a dominant common-mode offset in raw z_world; without it centering is a no-op by construction and the claim is untested rather than falsified. Statistic is the WORST (minimum) seed, matching the all-seeds quantifier in met.
preconditions.control: P0 write-free probe pass over the nursery with a centering=False agent; arm-invariant because centering never touches the encoder, only cue COMPARISON

preconditions.name: R2_super_ordinal_writes_fire
preconditions.description: Non-vacuity gate: every cell must fire at least one super-ordinal write, else anchor_count is measured over an empty set (the V3-EXQ-669a defect). Worst cell reported, matching the min quantifier in met.
preconditions.control: forced supra-threshold benefit every step in both arms

preconditions.name: R3_anchor_bank_cap_headroom
preconditions.description: SAME-STATISTIC censoring guard on the DV C1 routes on: no arm may saturate super_ordinal_n_slots, else anchor_count is censored and a NULL is uninterpretable. V3-EXQ-669c saturated at n_slots=64, which is why this run uses 1024. Scored against the NULL branch only -- censoring can only shrink the centered arm, so it can never manufacture a C1 pass.
preconditions.control: n_slots minus the maximum anchor_count over all cells

interpretation.combination_rule: PASS requires C1 (behavioural: anchor cardinality) AND C3 (geometric: cue-key pairwise spread), each on >= ceil(2/3 * n_seeds) seeds, and only after R1 and R2 hold. The two are deliberately independent -- C3 is the asserted CAUSE measured on a fixed P0 probe, C1 the closed-loop CONSEQUENCE -- so C1-pass/C3-fail is informative rather than contradictory. C2 and C3R are reported context and never enter the verdict.

criteria.name: C3_centered_key_spreads_cue_geometry
criteria.unit: seeds passing (P0 frac of pairwise cosines < 0.8: centered worst-case minus raw >= margin)

criteria.name: C3R_centered_higher_mean_complexity_REPORTED
criteria.unit: seeds passing (mean_complexity over fired writes, centered - raw >= margin) -- DILUTES with run length, reported only

evidence_direction_note: [2026-09-16 governance, cycle governance-20260916] supports (SD-077), ratified at the Step 2b walk with a logged driver skim: C1 85/37/60 vs 1/1/1 anchors (bar +4), C3 2/3 seeds on the pre-registered majority rule (seed 43 real miss 0.313 vs 0.50); caveat -- closed loop never diverged between arms (arm_common_mode_ratio identical to 6 decimals), so this is an open-loop live replication with real writes, not a closed-loop test.
